contract.evidence_interpretation: Saved official40-motor development candidacy only; no pooled native rate, no semantic/task novelty filter
contract.private_seed_convention: onset._seed(case,query,0); changes motor/noise RNG only, never physical reset seed

recipe.warmup_condition: replay >500 query chunks after a complete episode
recipe.action_bounds: Gaussian warmup unbounded; learned32D noise clipped[-1,1]
recipe.query_behavior: Native independent H10 Gaussian before any update; stochastic sample_actions SAC after update
recipe.interface: Official image64 pixels + proprio8, one camera; no VLA-prefix student features
recipe.departures: pi0.5 H10/ex10; actual-duration discount; development headroom selection; 20k-update/20-query panels

contract.job_authority: Human authorizes each job under8h and independent parallel experiments; finite phase uses resumable slices, no campaign8h cap

gpu_identity_mapping.method: scheduler NVIDIA UUID set + CUDA/NVML PCI bijection + own-PID allocation
